# clio sync keygen

Create the sync key in the recorded store and record the choice; the key is printed exactly once and cannot be recovered except with `clio sync key export`

## Usage

```
clio sync keygen [--store file|keystore] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

creates the key in the recorded store (the recommended file store when none is recorded), records the store choice, and prints the key exactly once; it cannot be recovered except with `clio sync key export`; the key never leaves the node except through that export; generating a new key on a node that already holds one rotates: the node seals with the newest key and opens with any key it holds; a rotation is not done until every peer holds the new key — give it to each peer, confirm the fingerprint matches with `clio sync key status` on both sides, and only then rely on it; a peer that has not been given the new key dead-letters every inbound row and its pull cursor freezes until it gets one, while content sealed under a key the peer still holds stays readable

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--store file\|keystore` | enum: file, keystore |  | Chooses where `sync_key_cli::keygen` writes the key via `KeySource::parse`: `file` or `keystore`; absent, the recorded choice or the recommended `file` store decides. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Create the key and print it exactly once.
```
clio sync keygen
```

Create the key in the file store.
```
clio sync keygen --store file
```

Create the key in the file store and report it as JSON.
```
clio sync keygen --store file -o json
```
